rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent perimeter mass with a carved interior void, and the void is visibly doing programmatic work rather than acting as decorative subtraction. Across views, the same U-like gesture holds together, so it is not coherent in only one projection. The blue access edge is answered by a legible ground response: an open court/entry seam along the frontage side rather than a sealed wall. The silhouette is somewhat stepped and folded, but the stepping remains secondary to the dominant mass envelope, so it does not collapse into arbitrary terrace stacking. Program-wise, this can plausibly support neighborhood living / mixed neighborhood use because it offers a clear public threshold, upper mass, and usable open space. The references mostly reinforce courtyard-perimeter and active-edge principles; the bridge precedent is appropriately treated as counterfactual and not imitated.
